justification: The assessment refutes the torsion-code converse, a different claim from the ground-truth Gray-image converse. Its witness is valid: for C=⟨(1,1)⟩ over Z₄, Tor₀(C)=Tor₁(C)=Tor₁(C)⊥={00,11}, but (1,1)·(1,1)=2 mod 4, so C is not self-dual. Sharing the ground-truth witness does not make the targeted claims identical.
